fields.name: work_area
fields.meaning: Not save data: scratch map and screen data rewritten during play, never read before written
fields.evidence: diffs during play with no save (map changes rewrite it); boot reads show no reads below 0x3300; save writes touch only 0x3300+

fields.name: unused_gap
fields.meaning: Not used; stays zero
fields.evidence: zero in every save image seen

fields.name: last_file
fields.meaning: Number of the file saved or loaded last (0-2 = file 1-3); file menus open with the cursor on it; reset to 0 when no file is valid
fields.evidence: code 4000:6A0C (save stores slot), 4000:6B18 (load stores cursor), 4000:6B04 (read at power-on, values above 2 treated as 0), 4000:6ACE (clears); natural saves show 0, 1, 2

fields.name: files
fields.meaning: Three save files of 0x43B bytes, file n (1-3) at 0x3301 + (n-1)*0x43B: a 0x439-byte copy of game RAM 0xD000-0xD438 plus a 16-bit checksum; rows below use file 1 positions
fields.evidence: code 4000:6A0C writer / 4000:69A4 reader; natural saves with 1, 2, 3 files filled

fields.name: m1_status
fields.meaning: Member 1 status: 0xFF = empty place; bit 0 = fallen (revivable); bit 1 = second inactive state; bits 2-3 = alternate portrait (ailment); 0 = normal
fields.evidence: code 4000:9690 (revive tests/clears bit 0), 4000:4CB1/3B60 (test bits 0-1), 4000:6913/1793 (portrait variants), 4000:7854 (0xFF handling); natural save = 0

fields.name: m1_name
fields.meaning: Member 1 name, 4 characters shown on the file list and status screen; verified codes 0x00 = hiragana A, 0xD9 = blank
fields.evidence: natural save holds 00 00 D9 D9 shown as "aa" (hiragana) on both screens; drawn by code 4000:66C6/14C1

fields.name: m1_type
fields.meaning: Member 1 race/monster type number (0xB1 = starting human male); picks stats row, type name and portrait
fields.evidence: code 4000:11F8/B21A (stats), 4000:12F6 (name), 4000:6913 (portrait); story scripts overwrite it (C000:3E6E and others)

fields.name: m1_hp
fields.meaning: Member 1 current HP
fields.evidence: natural save = 3 shown as "HP 3" on both screens; code 4000:66C6 display, 4000:11F8 set-to-max, 4000:9690 set-to-1

fields.name: m1_max_hp
fields.meaning: Member 1 maximum HP
fields.evidence: natural save = 60 shown as "3/60"; code 4000:11F8

fields.name: m1_hearts
fields.meaning: Member 1 hearts: low 4 bits = remaining lives; high 4 bits = race flags from the type table (0x80 default, 0x40 or 0x20); revive keeps flags, decrements count
fields.evidence: code 4000:B21A (init 3 + flag), 4000:9690 (preserve/decrement), 4000:14C1/66C6 (display & 0xF); natural save 0x83

fields.name: m1_abilities
fields.meaning: Member 1 four ability values from the type table, displayed in this order on the status screen
fields.evidence: code 4000:11F8/B21A copy table bytes 5-8, 4000:14C1 display; natural save 8,1,4,0

fields.name: m1_items
fields.meaning: Member 1 eight item places of (item number, uses left); 0xFE uses = unlimited; FF FF = empty
fields.evidence: code 4000:11F8 fill, 5000:7D76 search, menus 4000:3126/333A; natural save holds items 0x5E and 0x21

fields.name: m2
fields.meaning: Party member 2, same 0x1F-byte layout as member 1; first byte 0xFF when empty
fields.evidence: code 4000:14C1/106D; natural save empty (FF then zeros)

fields.name: m3
fields.meaning: Party member 3, same 0x1F-byte layout as member 1; first byte 0xFF when empty
fields.evidence: code 4000:14C1/106D; natural save empty (FF then zeros)

fields.name: m4
fields.meaning: Party member 4, same 0x1F-byte layout as member 1; first byte 0xFF when empty
fields.evidence: code 4000:14C1/106D; natural save empty (FF then zeros)

fields.name: bag
fields.meaning: Shared bag: eight item places of (item number, uses); FF FF = empty
fields.evidence: code 4000:106D (0xFF fill), 4000:2BFC (lists 8 pairs), 4000:40C4; natural save all empty

fields.name: key_items
fields.meaning: Nine key ("important things") items of (item number, uses); second byte 0xFF = empty
fields.evidence: code 4000:2C8A (lists 9 pairs), 5000:8092 give / 5000:7D76 search (loops of 9); natural save all empty

fields.name: unknown_9e
fields.meaning: Unknown; zero in every save and never read or written by any code; most likely unused padding
fields.evidence: zero in all saves; no code references to RAM 0xD09E-0xD0A1 in the full listing

fields.name: money
fields.meaning: Money, capped at 999999
fields.evidence: code 6000:38F5 (add + cap 0x0F423F), 4000:9690 (revive costs 100), 4000:9C62 (set to max), 4000:8083 (display); natural save 0

fields.name: progress_nibbles
fields.meaning: Sixteen 4-bit progress counters, counter i in byte i/2 (even i = high half)
fields.evidence: code 4000:84FD/5000:7E03 read, 5000:4971/7E1E write, 5000:B900 use; natural save all 0

fields.name: event_bits_ae
fields.meaning: One-time event bits; set when the event runs so it never repeats
fields.evidence: code 5000:B900 (sets 0x10<<n), C000:3A90 (script sets any bit); natural save 0x01

fields.name: vehicles
fields.meaning: Three parked-transport records of (map, x, y, reserved 0); dismounting stores the current position here
fields.evidence: code 5000:84E2/848A (store/clear), 5000:BB52 + ROM table 4000:10F0 (defaults); natural save = defaults

fields.name: event_flags
fields.meaning: Story event flags, one bit each: flag k = byte k/8, bit k mod 8 (216 flags)
fields.evidence: code 5000:7DD1 test, 5000:7DEA set; natural save all 0

fields.name: riding
fields.meaning: Which parked record is ridden: 0 = on foot, 1-3
fields.evidence: code 5000:84E2/848A (set on mount, clear on dismount); natural save 0

fields.name: return_point
fields.meaning: Pre-warp position (map, x, y): saved before every warp, restored when leaving through an exit
fields.evidence: code 5000:82FF/8391 (save then jump; exit index restores); new game 01 11 22, natural save 01 12 26

fields.name: max_floor
fields.meaning: Highest tower floor reached ("Nth floor reached" line)
fields.evidence: code 4000:66C6 display, 5000:1334 update-to-max; natural save 1

fields.name: current_floor
fields.meaning: Tower floor the party stands on ("now on floor N" line)
fields.evidence: code 4000:66C6 display, 5000:1334 set-from-map; natural save 1

fields.name: position
fields.meaning: Current position (map, x, y)
fields.evidence: code 4000:106D init, 5000:82FF/8391/BB52 warp tables, 5000:84E2 copy; natural save 58 0B 0D

fields.name: play_time
fields.meaning: Play time in screen frames (75 per second), shown as hours:minutes (frames/4500, clamped to 99:59)

fields.name: leader
fields.meaning: Party member (0-3) shown on the file list: portrait, name, HP, hearts
fields.evidence: code 4000:66C6/6913 use, 4000:4CB1 reorder sync; natural save 0

fields.name: carry_over
fields.meaning: 0xFF when saved for a carry-over run; loading it starts a new game that keeps the clear mark, settings, monster book and trailing unknown bytes
fields.evidence: code 4000:6102 (set when RAM 0xD700 set), 4000:7854/7B09 (load path + message); natural save 0

fields.name: clear_mark
fields.meaning: Nonzero draws an extra mark by the file and survives carry-over loading
fields.evidence: code 4000:66C6 draw, 4000:7854 restore; natural save 0

fields.name: msg_speed
fields.meaning: Message speed: each text character waits value+1 ticks; settings show value+1
fields.evidence: code 4000:7722/106D default 4, 4000:737C display, 4000:0956/09CE delay loop

fields.name: option_switches
fields.meaning: On/off settings, one bit each (bits 0-3 on the settings screen, bit 4 used by field/battle code); default 0x1F
fields.evidence: code 4000:7722 default, 4000:737C display, 5000:0863/6000:0B2E use; natural save 0x1F

fields.name: y_buttons
fields.meaning: Y1-Y4 button assignments (defaults 3,1,8,2)
fields.evidence: code 4000:7722 defaults, 4000:75ED list, 4000:1310 use

fields.name: monster_book
fields.meaning: Monster book: one bit per type 0-149, set when a member becomes that type
fields.evidence: code 4000:5EF9 set via 5EB7, 4000:5F29 test, 4000:5E5A clear; natural save all 0 (start type 0xB1 outside book)

fields.name: unknown_ff
fields.meaning: Unknown; zero in every save, no code references, but kept with the settings and book across carry-over loading
fields.evidence: part of the 0x1F carry-over bytes at 4000:7854; zero everywhere

fields.name: m1_history
fields.encoding: u16le, u16le, u8 x100, u8 x100
fields.meaning: Party place 1 type-change record: entry count (max 999), next ring position (99 down to 0, wraps), 100 type numbers, 100 bytes stored with them
fields.evidence: code 4000:5EB7 add, 4000:5E8D init (0, 99, 0xFF), 4000:5F89 reorder move; natural save count 1, next 98, type 0xB1 at index 99

fields.name: m2_history
fields.meaning: Party place 2 type-change record, same layout as place 1
fields.evidence: code 4000:5E8D table of 4, 4000:5F89; natural save empty (0, 99, 0xFF)

fields.name: m3_history
fields.meaning: Party place 3 type-change record, same layout as place 1
fields.evidence: code 4000:5E8D table of 4, 4000:5F89; natural save empty (0, 99, 0xFF)

fields.name: m4_history
fields.meaning: Party place 4 type-change record, same layout as place 1
fields.evidence: code 4000:5E8D table of 4, 4000:5F89; natural save empty (0, 99, 0xFF)

fields.name: magic
fields.meaning: Marker bytes 1B E4; a file without them counts as empty or broken
fields.evidence: code 4000:6A0C writes into RAM before saving, 4000:69E1 requires them

fields.name: pad_437
fields.meaning: First byte: zeroed padding, never used. Second byte: never initialized or written; raw RAM saved as-is (0 in every save seen)
fields.evidence: 4000:106D bulk zero ends at 0xD437; no references to 0xD438 anywhere

fields.name: checksum
fields.meaning: Checksum: 16-bit sum of the 0x439 body bytes; erased files store sum+1 so the check fails
fields.evidence: code 4000:6A48 write, 4000:69E1 check, 4000:6A62/6A96 erase; recomputed on every valid copy (file 1 0x5841, file 2 0x590E, file 3 0x58DC)

fields.name: backup_files
fields.meaning: Second copy of each file at file + 0xCB1, written together with the first; the loader falls back to it only when the first fails
fields.evidence: code 4000:6A0C writes both, 4000:69A4 falls back; copies identical in every save

fields.name: unused_tail
fields.meaning: Not used; stays zero
fields.evidence: zero in every save image seen
